correctness.rationale: Enumerated every nonempty independence face of standard Cayley Shrikhande on Z4² with ±(1,0), ±(0,1), ±(1,1) and of the 4×4 rook graph. Both have 16 degree-six vertices and 48 edges; exact face vectors (16,72,96,16) and (16,72,96,24). Independently regenerated both deterministic vertex-toggle matchings, 88 and 96 matched Hasse pairs, respectively; acyclic directed Hasse orientation verified by independent full Kahn traversal of all 200 / 208 faces and 496 / 528 Hasse covers. Unmatched cells: precisely one 0-simplex and 23 / 15 two-simplices. Forman Morse CW model then a point with only degree-two attachments, necessarily wedges of 23 and 15 copies of S². This proves integral homotopy rather than extrapolating from mod2 Betti alone. The auxiliary polynomial recursion was separately inspected.
